brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

cover:0,0,0;full;top on central cell with handle:0,0,0;top (plus 3 Trinity inserts at 60/180/300deg) - central balanced lift point

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) for screws and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) for bits - two separate divided full-depth bins on outer cells

finish.summary: 3-cell bar caddy verified meshClash clear: central cell provides handle via cover+Trinity handle, outer cells provide 2-compartment and 3-compartment divided bins for screws/bits separation. Double side-connectors join all three bases for carry rigidity.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text:
Tool caddy built as a compact 3-cell bar for hand carry.

**Layout:** three full bases in line ( -1,0,0 | 0,0,0 | 1,0,0 ) linked with side-connector-double at level 0 to make a rigid caddy body.

**Carry handle:** central cell 0,0,0 fitted with a full cover (top) + handle on top (handle:0,0,0;top with its three trinity inserts at 60/180/300 deg). This is the engineered carry point - load shared across the cover rather than a single stud.

**Divided storage:** 
- left cell -1,0,0 = bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) - ideal for screws / larger fixings
- right cell 1,0,0 = bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) - ideal for bits / small accessories
Both are full-depth drop-in bins hanging on their rims, no fixings needed.

Mesh clash is clear; only info is open cap faces (cosmetic).
